0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, 0-4 on the road, 15th in the West, 4.5 games back in the Pacific) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak, 7th in the West) for the Kings' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle; 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes per game this season), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Dallas, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back, is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 130-121 win in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
